title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from the heart of the Middle East, featuring marinated lamb skewers grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, ghee or oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or flatbread.
